## 序页 1.3

把常用网页放进新标签页：每行六个位置，支持拖放、分组、置顶、两行标题，以及多次撤销和重做。页面顶部的标签副本可拖成卡片，右下角按钮可切换到独立的第二页。

壁纸默认每分钟更换，支持收藏相册、原图链接和批量下载。设置中可调整间隔、亮度、不透明度及中英文语言。

下载对应浏览器的 ZIP，解压后在扩展管理页开启开发者模式，选择“加载已解压的扩展程序”。安装步骤和 AI 部署入口见 [中文说明](https://github.com/zzy2670/Prelude/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)。

## Prelude 1.3

Keep webpages on your new-tab page in six-column groups. Drag cards into place, pin regular pages, edit two-line titles, and undo or redo multiple changes. Drag a tab copy from the top strip to save it as a card. Switch to a separate second page with the bottom-right button.

Wallpapers change every minute by default. Save images to an album, open their original URLs, or download the collection. Adjust the interval, brightness, opacity and language in Settings.

Download the ZIP for Chrome or Edge, extract it, enable Developer mode on the extensions page, and choose **Load unpacked**. See the [installation guide and AI deployment entry](https://github.com/zzy2670/Prelude#install-in-chrome-or-edge).

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the checksums of both browser packages.
